name: Trying Times

angles.text: Healthy gryphons matter to Alliance travel and communication across Khaz Modan, especially when local dangers threaten regional security.
As a dwarf, you know an ill-tempered gryphon can be as dangerous as an enemy. Proper feeding and care come before flight.
As a gnome, you may hear Howin compare Razormaw egg yolks to a gnome's noggin, a vivid dwarven measure.

faq.answer: Howin Kindfeather is a dwarf who tends to Bassbeak, his gryphon in the Wetlands. He asks for fresh raptor eggs to feed her before he puts his plans into motion.
Bassbeak is Howin Kindfeather's gryphon. When she is hungry, she grows irritable and dangerous, so riding her before she has eaten is unsafe.
Howin seeks Razormaw raptor eggs because he says untainted food is scarce in the Wetlands. Their large, nourishing yolks can satisfy Bassbeak's appetite.
faq.q: Why does Howin need raptor eggs?

faq.answer: Razormaw raptors live at Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest in the Wetlands. Their nests hold the eggs Howin seeks.
faq.q: Where can Razormaw raptors be found?

faq.answer: Howin asks for eggs without cracks or flaws so Bassbeak gets fresh, untainted food instead of spoiled scraps.
faq.q: Why do the eggs need to be perfect?

aliases: what are howin and bassbeak planning
faq.answer: Howin has a broader plan for Bassbeak, but keeps its details secondary until she is fed and calm enough to fly safely amid the dangers of the region.
faq.q: What is Howin planning to do with Bassbeak?

sections.body: Howin Kindfeather works with Bassbeak in the Wetlands. The dwarf will not fly with his gryphon until her appetite is satisfied. A hungry gryphon is stubborn and unpredictable, and may lash out. A proper meal comes before any flight through the marshes.
sections.title: Appeasing a Hungry Gryphon

sections.body: Howin seeks food for Bassbeak from the Razormaw raptors. Their nests lie at Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest. Razormaw eggs have yolks as large as a gnome's head, giving Bassbeak the substantial meal Howin wants before facing the dangers of the Wetlands.
sections.title: The Razormaw Bounty

summary: Howin Kindfeather needs help feeding Bassbeak before the gryphon can take flight. He seeks a dozen intact eggs from the fierce Razormaw raptors of the Wetlands.
